text:
maya: Heads up — PR gate flaky again. Several PRs hit eval CI timeout, but nightly runs were fine. noticed this after landing a small quantization config change.

oliver: ugh. any logs? is it the runner saturating or artifact upload failing?

maya: attaching excerpt — several jobs stuck waiting on artifact download for >3m then GH Actions cancels due to job-level timeout. root cause looks like race between artifact upload (from build step) and parallel consumers.

maya: log snippet:
```
Run: download-eval-artifact
Downloading artifact eval-shard-9...
Status: 0 bytes after 120s, retrying
Error: timeout after 180s
```

ryan: saw similar yesterday w/ matrix=quant-modes. buildkite didn't have this because we stream shards differently. could be the artifact name collision + stale cache key.

tara: @ryan can you confirm if the uploader uses unique run id? I remember a change that switched to `eval-name` only.

ryan: checked — uploader uses `${{ matrix.model }}-eval` not run id, so two parallel jobs end up reading the wrong shard if they start early. that plus GH Actions' eventual consistency on artifacts explains the intermittent failures.

ci-bot: workflow run 2119876000 -gha-evals-pr - failed (job: download-eval-artifact)

maya: short-term workaround: make PR gate use smoke eval (single shard) to avoid parallel artifact consumers. long-term: change artifact keys and make consumers poll with a small exponential backoff + stronger existence check.

oliver: agree. also can we add `concurrency` lock to the workflow so uploads complete before consumers start? e.g.
```
concurrency:
  group: eval-${{ github.ref }}-${{ matrix.model }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
```

ryan: good idea. Also propose changing artifact upload to include `run_id` and `job_attempt` in the filename and add a 15s prefetch loop in the downloader: try 6x with sleep 2,4,8,... so short spikes don't fail the job.

tara: can we also gate full evals to a dedicated nightly only? PRs should only run smoke by default (speed + stability).

maya: agreed. i'll open TICKET-2243 to: (1) update GH Actions artifact naming, (2) add downloader backoff, (3) switch PR gate to smoke eval, (4) add concurrency group where appropriate. assigning to @ryan for uploader patch and @tara to update workflows.

eval-runner: note: once naming change is in, we should run a stress job (10 parallel PR-like runs) to validate.

oliver: +1. also add a small dashboard panel showing failed artifact downloads per hour so ops can spot regressions early.

maya: thanks everyone. i'll post a follow-up with a short diff for the workflow and the ticket link. :thumbsup:
